candidates.venue: Wooden Shoe Books, 704 South St, Philadelphia, PA 19147
candidates.description:
We are working, which means: follow the boss’s orders. Or we are unemployed, which means: beg for meaningless work. Every second a fresh chance — to consume our time with someone else’s profit production.

The Earth can not sustain more surplus value. But there is a “surplus imagination” to be harvested. Again and again we flee the rulers’ capture of our time. We steal time to make our own ideas, words, and images. These acts can interrupt our work and job-hunt. They can make us less fit for work and consumption — more distracted or exhausted. They can mean a flight from the system of profits.…
